fields.description: Stable identifier, generated once and copied verbatim when a version is cloned. Progress and checkpoints key off this, so reordering or inserting blocks never invalidates a learner's place.
fields.label: Block Key

fields.description: What kind of thing this block is. External Embed cannot be checkpointed or coverage-gated — see the module README.
fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Rich Text
Image
PDF
Video
External Embed
Callout
Downloadable File
Divider

fields.description: Optional heading shown above the block.
fields.label: Heading

fields.description: The body text. Sanitized on the server before it is ever served to a learner.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: Stored as a private file; the runtime serves it only to a learner with an active enrollment.
fields.label: File

fields.description: The video to play. Register it once as a Training Video Asset so its duration is probed rather than typed.
fields.label: Video

fields.description: Fetched from the asset. Coverage is measured against this, which is why it is never hand-entered here.
fields.label: Duration (Seconds)

fields.description: A Drive preview or unlisted video URL. Convenient, but the player cannot see into a cross-origin frame: no checkpoints and no watch coverage for this block.
fields.label: Embed URL

fields.description: Optional still shown before playback starts.
fields.label: Poster Image

fields.description: Optional caption shown under the block.
fields.label: Caption

fields.description: Untick for supporting material the learner may skip.
fields.label: Required to Finish the Lesson

fields.description: Per-block override of the course's minimum watch coverage. Leave at 0 to use the course setting. Ignored for External Embed — the player cannot measure it.
fields.label: Minimum Watched (%)

fields.description: Pause the video to ask the checkpoint questions attached to this block. Ignored for External Embed.
fields.label: Ask Checkpoint Questions
